findings.text: blocking: the routing ceiling assertion is judged at the real wall clock — _routing_ceiling calls _budget_verdict with no now, so effective_block falls back to datetime.now(UTC), and the fixture lift (granted 2026-10-08T03:12Z, reset 2026-10-14T05:12Z) is in force only while real time sits inside that window; from 2026-10-14T05:12Z the assertion reads 92 not 100 and the test reddens with no code change, so it is a fuse of the kind this repo bans. Fix: pass now through _routing_ceiling into _budget_verdict.

follow-on: no production caller of _budget_verdict passes readings, so effective_block on routing's path resolves the lift with readings=None; a reset-anchored lift there ends only at its recorded resets_at and cannot observe an early reset the way dispatch_admission (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:324) does, so an early-reset lift keeps the resume and coordinator reserves released on that reader's path until the recorded stamp passes.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the bookend, resume and coordinator reserves read the group's effective budget block; the diff routes dispatch_admission's bookend refusal (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:321), budget_group.group_figures' reserve_pct (reckon/crew/budget_group.py:423) and the budget.policy call on routing's path (reckon/crew/routing.py:398) through budget_group.effective_block.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records head-gate (111 passed), base-gate (104 passed), negative-control (4 failed, EXIT=1) with the mutation verbatim, and commit 0eeba7d, and its fields reconcile with the logs on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is the three source files, the new test file, a docs evidence fragment and a figures dir; the diff touches exactly the three source files, the test file and the fragment, every path inside the grant, and the figures dir was not needed.

justifications.durability: the negative control (logs/negative-control.log) reddens the ceiling and admit assertions when effective_budget is bypassed, but the routing assertion at tests/test_reserves_read_the_lift.py:310 is judged at the real clock rather than the fixture's now.
justifications.evidence: the head and base arms are logged at 60df715 (logs/head-gate.log 111 passed, logs/base-gate.log 104 passed) and the negative control reddens 4 cases at EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:396 defers the budget_group import to call time, matching the module's existing lazy-import idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/budget_group.py:218 composes the lift and the review-exclusion rule in one resolution and all three reserve readers call it.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/budget_group.py:218 extends the owners budget_lift.effective_budget and reserve_block_for_group rather than re-implementing either, and no other reserve-releasing composition exists under reckon/crew.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff — reckon/crew/budget_group.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, reckon/crew/routing.py and tests/test_reserves_read_the_lift.py — lies inside the declared write paths.
